name: Space Leaping with Occupancy Map
definition: A hardware-efficient space leaping mechanism that skips empty sub-cubes in a volume dataset using a small occupancy map stored in on-chip SRAM, avoiding the need for a full distance volume.
summary: Space Leaping with Occupancy Map is a hardware-efficient volume ray casting acceleration technique that skips empty sub-cubes using a compact SRAM-based occupancy map, prioritizing low-latency lookup over distance fields.
